script.text:
set -eu
echo "Installing system dependencies..."
apt-get update && apt-get install -y aria2 osmium-tool gdal-bin curl ca-certificates tar
echo "Installing uv to /usr/local/bin..."
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | env UV_INSTALL_DIR="/usr/local/bin" sh
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1"
mkdir -p /var/tmp/geodashing-work/app
cd /var/tmp/geodashing-work/app
echo "Fetching code bundle from GCS..."
META_JSON=$(curl -s -f -H "Metadata-Flavor: Google" "http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token")
TOKEN=$(printf '%s' "${META_JSON}" | sed -n 's/.*"access_token":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
test -n "${TOKEN}"
curl -f -L -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" "https://storage.googleapis.com/storage/v1/b/geodashing-v2-map-data/o/batch%2Fgeodashing-roads-bundle.tar.gz?alt=media" -o bundle.tar.gz
tar -xzf bundle.tar.gz
rm -f bundle.tar.gz
echo "Synchronizing Python environment..."
uv sync --no-dev
echo "Running prepare_roads pipeline (with 7-day GCS cache and multi-mirror download)..."
uv run --no-sync python -m backend.scripts.prepare_roads --download-planet-osm --input /var/tmp/geodashing-work/planet-latest.osm.pbf --output /var/tmp/geodashing-work/world_drivable_roads.gpkg --delete-input --upload-gcs
